headline: Trump, Xi, and Putin Plan Summit on Sidelines of APEC Meeting
summary: Officials confirmed U.S. President Donald Trump, Chinese President Xi Jinping, and Russian President Vladimir Putin plan to hold a trilateral meeting Thursday on the sidelines of the APEC summit.
why: High-level meetings between the leaders of the U.S., China, and Russia influence global trade relations, economic sanctions, and geopolitical stability.

impacts.name: S&P 500
impacts.why: Anticipation of major geopolitical trade talks introduces broad market policy expectations.
